PRACTICE MANAGER
Executive Summary
Strategic, motivational, and solutions-focused leader with an MBA and with extensive experience in analyzing systems/processes and implementing mission-critical infrastructure improvements. Broad based experience in the healthcare industry including regulatory and corporate compliance, planning, and contract negotiations. Craft and implement key quality improvements to enhance quality patient care, solution regulatory compliance, develop proven track record of success in developing solutions which significantly improve the efficiency of business operations; experience collaborating effectively with colleagues, executives, and client groups.

Core Qualifications
Proficient in Windows 2000, 2003, XP, Novell NetWare 4.x, 5.x/6.x; EMR (Allscripts and McKesson); TCP/IP Enterprise Networks, Enterprise Windows Server 2000/2003; HP AA/HTEC

Professional Experience
Practice Manager Aug 2014 to Current
Company Name ¼/City, State
* Develop annual planning, budgeting, and productivity levels for corporate accounting.
* Prepare detailed business and financial activity reports and use financial ratios and statistical trending for market-wide growth.
* Improvements to top line growth by 39.4% through building an effective hospital team, ensuring a safe and engaging environment, and improving medical quality and business performance.
* Responsible cost control, cash forecasting, asset protection, loss prevention, inventory management, Federal and DEA compliance.
* Develop and deploy new hospital initiatives including training physician partners, implementing an efficient patient workflow from intake to discharge and community marketing/outreach campaigns.
* Build client base by providing extraordinary service to existing clients and by initiating new marketing plans.
* Member of the Performance Improvement Committee and oversaw compliance department operations.

Information Technology Manager Feb 2012 to Sep 2013
Company Name ¼/City, State
* Ensured regulatory compliance and integrity of health information systems.
* Provided support during surveys, ADR, and internal audits.
* Mentored and ensured the professional development of new clinical employees by providing courses educational programs and supported seasonal clinical staff by making field visits.
* Member of the Performance Improvement Committee and oversaw compliance department operations.

Information Technology Manager Sep 2008 to Apr 2012
Company Name ¼/City, State
* Provided technical support, and developed strategic/operational plans to drive business outcomes.
* Revised legacy initiatives with an AXE-IT project (implementation of a new help desk system).
* Developed and implemented a framework for managing IT risk and compliance.
* Championed network infrastructure upgrades, including firewall and router replacements.
* Responsible for IT budget, operational planning, and vendor management.
* Implemented a comprehensive data protection policy and procedures.

Education
Bachelor of Science in Health Administration, June 1998
